title: Expanded Cooking
description: This datapack adds a new tree, new foods, and a new way to cook as well as replaces the leatherworker villager with a chef
body:
![Expanded Cooking title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccf6251213db01e21a79661eda93cf300b499f2c.png)
# Features
- Per-player settings menu to give you the option to play how you want!
- Recipe books can be found around the world in chests left behind by the Overworld and Nether Chefs!
- Many new recipes and food items!
- Fruit trees! Pick some fruit right off the tree and have a bite!
- The **_NEW_** Chef Villager (This replaces the Leatherworker Villager)


# Resource pack or Data pack?
One file to rule them all. This is both a resource pack AND a data pack in one file! Download the Expanded Cooking zip file and copy and paste it into both your resourcepack folder and your datapack folder.

### Notice

- WARNING! This datapack fully replaces all Leatherworker villagers with the new Chef villager! Any previously generated leatherworkers will still contain their trades but will look like the chef!
- This datapack is still a work in progress and is not finished, some features may be visible in-game but are broken or have not been implemented yet.
- Please consider joining my discord to report bugs or request features.
